immutableProtocolBoundary.family: The existing frozen specifications, three endpoints, complete-origin refusal, Holm denominator and missing-as-nonrejections remain unchanged. The bridge does not add tests to or remove tests from the family.
immutableProtocolBoundary.acceptance: authenticityVerified=false, scientificAcceptance=false, investmentEvidence=false and efficacy=WITHHELD remain unconditional. Caller payload hashes and source declarations do not establish original publication, independent authenticity or positive historical results.

frozenInputs: Every declared 12-month origin must have exactly one deployment in its cell schedule and a complete paired origin period from which the existing sector quantile weights are recomputed.

A stream cannot bind multiple specifications. Entry notional must equal ranked weights times that cohort's contributed capital, and each trade identity, price and FX must match that selected origin period's execution quotes; no full-portfolio capital is reinvested at each origin.

Factor names/dimensions, construction payload hash, provider, decimal-monthly convention and currency-conversion description are frozen separately for Kenneth French regional developed-market and workbook-universe factors.
The protocol's existing 25bp one-way traded-notional cost remains primary. The bridge is not a synthetic rerun of historical sensitivity portfolios.
monthlyEvidence: Complete simultaneous post-deployment/post-settlement marks from the first deployment to the last maturity, at exact UTC first-of-month boundaries; no skipped months.

Every previous live cohort has an exact monthly event book carrying opening units, cash and restricted cash forward. Dated dividends, splits, mergers, delistings and borrow/collateral events use the existing unchanged event engine.

Explicit financing and interest coverage, including zero; observed borrow or an explicit hypothetical fee assumption and short collateral coverage; maturity liquidation trades and released collateral; explicit entry/exit cost receipts. Missing costs/rates do not default to zero.

Unknown borrow preserves reconciled accounting and monthly inference with a hypothetical-research label on the stream, affected monthly rows and attribution. Explicit assumptions are retained, including the nonzero .02 fee in the focused case. Known unavailable borrow and missing both observed and assumed fees still refuse. Hypothetical research never establishes investability, authenticity, positive family acceptance or scientific acceptance.
Reserve-rate receipts, including zero, must be known at the opening boundary and reconcile opening unallocated capital and elapsed time.

Every mark, entry receipt, monthly book, event, dated factor row and risk-free row resolves to a retained payload hash within corpus cutoff. Entry execution receipts may become available after signal origin, but must be known by execution; this does not relax the existing origin-relative signal gates. Monthly payload checks also apply to engineering fixtures.

One row per actual monthly NAV interval joins both geography/currency-matched factor sets and a dated risk-free return. Duplicate events within a sleeve are refused. Annual endpoint returns never enter the monthly row builder.

The same date-block bootstrap settings are applied to the monthly rows, with the existing >=12 block-length requirement for declared 12-month cells. Alpha and intervals are monthly, not silently annualized. Evaluation boundaries must be retained monthly boundaries.

entryCostTiming.legacyIssue: The old invariant initial sleeve NAV=capital cannot represent an entry expense in a post-trade mark. It is preserved for old callers and is not treated as evidence of zero entry costs.
entryCostTiming.versionedResolution: The optional explicit deployment-cost argument reconciles initial post-entry sleeve NAV + entry cost = contributed capital. The first monthly return uses original initialCapital as opening NAV, so initial entry expense is charged in that first month rather than discarded. Later entry expenses reduce simultaneous NAV at their actual deployment boundary.
entryCostTiming.noDoubleCounting: Only bridge.rows are monthly return observations. bridge.accounting is a boundary/capital audit including the post-entry initial boundary; its initial netReturn is not an additional monthly observation. Settled cash funds later deployments once and is excluded from live sleeve assets.
